products.title: Black Tears Cuban Spiced Rum 700ml
products.descriptionHtml:
Black Tears Cuban Spiced Rum 700ml

🔥 Passion. Spice. The Soul of Cuba.

Born in the heart of Cuba and infused with emotion, Black Tears is the world’s first Cuban spiced rum, blending authentic Cuban rum 🇨🇺 with local spices like coffee ☕, cacao 🍫, and aji dulce 🌶️. Smooth yet complex, it delivers a bold, bittersweet profile that’s perfect for sipping or mixing into richly flavoured cocktails.

Crafted for the curious and the passionate, Black Tears is a love letter to Cuban rhythm, soul, and rebellion—a rum that breaks the rules beautifully.

🖤 Why You’ll Love It:

✔️ The world’s first Cuban spiced rum 🇨🇺
✔️ Infused with Cuban-grown coffee, cacao & sweet pepper
✔️ Perfect balance of sweetness, warmth & subtle heat 🔥
✔️ Incredibly versatile in cocktails or neat
✔️ Crafted in Cuba with centuries-old rum tradition

From Havana nights to home bars, Black Tears brings depth and drama to every pour. 

Featured in the Pina Colada Cocktail Pack and the Caribbean Tiki Essentials Pack 

🍊 Spiced Rum Old Fashioned Recipe

Method:

1️⃣ In a rocks glass, stir 5ml sugar syrup or 1 brown sugar cube, 2 dashes aromatic bitters until dissolved (muddle if using a cube).

2️⃣ Add 60ml Black Tears Cuban Spiced Rum and plenty of ice.

3️⃣ Stir until well chilled and balanced.

4️⃣ Garnish with a twist of orange peel and a coffee bean for an aromatic finish.

products.title: Lanique Rose Spirit
products.descriptionHtml:
Creating rose tinted cocktails since 1785. 

Lanique is created by steam-distilling thousands of hand-picked rose petals that are sourced from the East. Once steam distilled, the rose petals release The Attar of Rose, a liquid that is more valuable, gram for gram, than gold itself. The Attar of Rose is then added in a slow, multi-part process with carefully selected sugars and a neutral grain spirit. The complex distillation process creates a truly unique flavour of Turkish Delight, a hint of cherry and the gorgeous aroma of the most beautiful Damascene rose. 

Appearance: Clear, bright pink. Aroma: Ripe rose and raspberry reminiscent of Turkish Delight; with soft hints of lime and strong spirit aromas.

Taste: A slightly syrupy, liqueur-like texture with sweet pastilles of rose, ripe raspberry and cherry. The initial warmth and sweetness spreads over the palate with an undertone of peppery spirit, soon to be contrasted with a subtle rind of lime, providing a fresh citrus hit.

Finish: Sweet rose and hints of white chocolate, with a subtle lime acidity and cracked black pepper spiciness provide a beautifully balanced finish.

Lanique, Spirit of Rose has been treasured by the Aristocracy across Europe since the late 1700s. The original recipe was rediscovered and recreated in 2015, and it is now proudly distilled in the UK. Now you too can enjoy the pure distillation of 18th century splendour recreated in this modern world.

brands.name: Black Tears
brands.description: Cuba’s first ever spiced rum, Black Tears is distilled from exceptional molasses, sourced from four adjoining mills in the province of Ciego de Avila. Black Tears is then infused with coffee and cacao, which have flavoured the history of Cuba itself, and spiced with ají dulce (sweet chilli), one of the most distinctive tastes in Cuban cuisine. The irresistible, bittersweet taste of Black Tears—and its low sugar content—sets it apart from other craft rum products. It’s distinct taste not only works perfectly in any Cuban classic; Daiquiri, Mojito or Cuba Libre, just add coffee and sweetener for a simple but delicious Espresso Martini. Or enjoy the rich characteristics of Black Tears simply over ice after a meal.

brands.name: Burnt Ends
brands.description: Experience the electrifying collision of flavors: where sweetness meets smoke in a mesmerizing marriage. Prepare for a tantalizing journey of rich and spicy sensations, infused with the alluring essence of smoky sausage, tangy BBQ sauce, and a delightful hint of apple juice dancing in the background. Our master whiskey blenders have meticulously crafted a one-of-a-kind, unconventional spirit that shatters the boundaries of tradition. It commands attention when savored neat (or enjoyed straight from the bottle). And yet, this smoldering giant beckons for exploration in both timeless classics and daring, contemporary cocktails.

brands.name: Demonio De Los Andes
brands.description: Pisco is a colorless or yellowish-to-amber colored brandy produced in winemaking regions of Peru and Chile. Made by distilling fermented grape juice into a high-proof spirit , it was developed by 16th-century Spanish-settlers as an alternative to orujo, a brandy that was being imported from Spain. It had the advantages of being produced from abundant domestically grown fruit and reducing the volume of alcoholic beverages transported to remote locations.

brands.name: Giffard
brands.description: Indulge in the epitome of premium taste with Giffard, expertly crafted in France with the finest silverbeet sugar. These syrups and liqueurs undergo a rigorous pasteurization process, ensuring a impeccable preservation. Specially designed for the discerning bartenders in the cocktail & bar industry, these syrups elevate any drink, be it a classic cocktail, mocktail, smoothie, milkshake or granita. Experience the ultimate in flavor with Giffard syrups and liqueurs.

brands.name: La Dama
brands.description: Indulge in the essence of sophistication with La Dama; the worlds finest organic unaged Tequila. Distilled from premium blue Weber agave, La Dama not only delivers in taste but also in their commitment to protecting the environment. The agave ranches, where the plant is grown, meticulously preserve the local flora and fauna, and even the bottle is made from recycled glass. To top it off, surplus agave fibers are utilized to create the labels and paper, making La Dama's Tequila not only a top-notch drink but also a socially responsible choice. Savor the best of both worlds with La Dama's organic unaged Tequila.

brands.name: Lanique
brands.description: Lanique is created by steam-distilling thousands of hand-picked rose petals that are sourced from the East. The complex distillation process creates a truly unique flavor of Turkish Delight, a hint of cherry and the gorgeous aroma of the most beautiful Damascene rose.

brands.name: Pueblo Viejo
brands.description: When we talk about Pueblo Viejo, we talk about years of stories and experiences; we talk about achievements in the production of tequila, because we are always searching for the perfect flavor. Pueblo Viejo is one of the leading brands of tequila in México; consistently delivering the ideal flavor balance and quality, Pueblo Viejo Tequila is the authentic tequila experience.

brands.name: Rum-Bar
brands.description: 100% Jamaican Pot-Still. Rum-Bar pays tribute to the traditional, community rum bars across Jamaica.

brands.name: Thoquino
brands.description: 100% sugar cane spirit produced in Brazil since 1906. Brazil’s national spirit, cachaça appeared in the 15th century, when the Portuguese brought knowledge of alembic pot distilling to the country. Cachaça Thoquino has been a staple for the people of Brazil for over 100 years. The family distillery, Thomaz de Aquino, carries out all the production process itself from its own sugar cane fields, which guarantees authenticity and quality.

Main Street that once served as home to the bourbon industry in Louisville, Kentucky.​ Whiskey Row is a one and only pre-prohibition style bourbon you would have found in a classy speakeasy or perhaps the Rathskeller Room at the Seelbach around the turn of the century.

recipes.bodyHtml:
Summer is almost here and with it comes delicious summer cocktails. This week we've got our hands on some delicious Rainfall Distillery Gin infused with Southern Forests Pinot Noir & Strawberry. Hailing from Western Australia's beautiful Southern Karri Forests, Rainfall Distillery are truly a gin lovers dream. This amazing gin is packed with the delicious sweetness of strawberry, to the rich dry notes of Pinot Noir.

This perfectly balanced Gin is an absolute must have for any home bartender or mixology enthusiast. 

Watch the full video here

Ingredients:

  • A handful of fresh basil leaves
  • 60ml Rainfall Strawberry Gin
  • 30ml Freshly squeezed lemon juice
  • 20ml Giffard Strawberry Syrup
  • Ice cubes
  • Additional basil leaves for garnish

Instructions:

  1. Gather Your Ingredients: Before you begin crafting this cocktail, ensure you have all the necessary ingredients at your disposal. You can conveniently find them online at drinksup.com.au.

  2. Muddle Basil Leaves: Take a few fresh basil leaves and gently muddle them in a cocktail shaker. Alternatively you can just throw them in the shaker for an almost identical result.

  3. Add Rainfall Strawberry Gin: Pour 60ml (or 2 oz) of Rainfall Strawberry Gin into the shaker. This exquisite gin is infused with the essence of Australian Rain, Strawberry and Pinot Noir, creating a unique and refreshing base for your cocktail.

  4. Squeeze in Lemon Juice: Next, add 30ml (or 1 oz) of freshly squeezed lemon juice to the shaker. The tartness of lemon will balance the sweetness of the strawberries and syrup.

  5. Sweeten with Strawberry Syrup: To enhance the strawberry flavour, incorporate 20ml (or 0.67 oz) of Giffard Strawberry Syrup into the mix. This syrup not only adds sweetness but also amplifies the fruity notes in your cocktail.

  6. Shake with Ice: Fill your cocktail shaker with ice cubes, ensuring it's well-packed. Shake vigorously for about 10-15 seconds until the mixture is thoroughly chilled.

  7. Strain and Serve: Using a fine strainer, pour your Strawberry and Basil Gin Smash into a lowball or rocks glass filled with fresh ice. This step helps ensure a silky-smooth texture.

  8. Garnish with Basil: Finally, garnish your cocktail with a few basil leaves. This not only adds a touch of elegance but also releases more of that delightful basil aroma with each sip.

Now, you're ready to savour the Strawberry and Basil Gin Smash, a vibrant and enchanting concoction that marries the sweetness of strawberries with the herbal grace of basil, all accentuated by the distinctive Rainfall Strawberry Gin.

Whether you're unwinding on a lazy Sunday or hosting a girls' night in, this cocktail is sure to impress. Don't forget to visit drinksup.com.au for all your cocktail ingredient needs, and let the Strawberry and Basil Gin Smash be the star of your next gathering. Cheers to sweet sips and even sweeter moments!

recipes.bodyHtml:
So as world rum day has drawn to a close, we're not stopping the celebration.

We've put together 4 Classic cocktails that highlight the best features of all our amazing rums. So get mixing with these simple, delicious cocktail recipes.

Canchanchara

Delve into the depths of Cuban heritage with the iconic Canchanchara cocktail. This timeless libation is often regarded as the predecessor to the renowned Daiquiri, The drink of choice for Cuban revolutionaries. The Canchanchara has since become a national favourite for Cubans everywhere. It's easy to see why; you'll discover the harmonious interplay of rich spiced rum, the sweetness of honey, and the vibrant zest of lime.

Canchanchara

60ml Black Tears Cuban Dry Spiced Rum
20ml Honey Syrup (3:1 Honey to water)
15ml Lime

Shake ingredients with ice and single strain to lowball filled with ice. Garnish with Lime.

Silvers End

This Silver rum is the world's only 100% pot still Jamaican rum, made on the prestigious Worthy Park Estate grounds; this rum marries the heritage and history of the distillery with modern techniques and accuracy. The result is a rum that will stoke the fire to start any party.
To Celebrate Rum-Bar Silver, we've created the Silvers End, A modern take on a Fog Cutter; We felt the rum should shine in this cocktail, so we've elevated it into a coupe to reveal all the wonderful aroma this cocktail brings whilst maintaining the tiki roots of the Fog Cutter.

To make Tiki Sugar Syrup: Lightly toast 6 Cinnamon Sticks, 4 Cloves, 4 Peppercorns, 1 star anise.
Then, Combine 2 Cups Almonds, All spices, 2 cups sugar and 1.5 Cups water. Stir over medium heat until steaming, allow to chill to room temperature, express 2 oranges of oil into the mix, Strain through cheesecloth then a fine oil filter. Store for up to 30 days chilled.

Painkiller

Picture this: it's the '70s, and at the legendary Soggy Dollar Bar, sun-soaked patrons would swim ashore with their cash pockets soaked. Their resourceful bartenders had a trick up their sleeves! Whilst everyone's wallets dried up in the tropical sun, they used the time to whip up a concoction of Pineapple, Overproof Rum, Coconut, and Orange Juice. And thus, the Painkiller was born.

This modern-day legend is the epitome of tiki vibes and a shining example of why Worthy Park Estates' Rum-Bar Overproof rules the rum game. It's all about that fresh-cut sugar cane, the hint of grass, and the kick of fermented pineapple. We're talkin' top-notch Overproof Rum.

45ml Rum-Bar Overproof Jamaican Rum
90ml Fresh Pineapple Juice

2 Drops Saline

Shake ingredients with ice, Strain and top with more ice, grated nutmeg and orange slice.

Passionfruit Daiquiri

Beloved by bartenders everywhere, The Daiquiri is revered for its simple formula of 3 Parts Spirit, 2 Parts Sour, 1 Part Sweet. (Thats a great idea, someone should name a drinks company after that!)
We've changed this one up by adding some delicious Giffard Passionfruit Syrup. You can easily make this cocktail your own by substituting the syrup for any flavour you like.

recipes.summary: The humble Pina Colada is a classic summer drink, but it's time to elevate your game and make it even better. The key to elevating your Pina Colada lies in the ingredients you use, and Giffard syrups
recipes.bodyHtml:
Giffard syrups are a great way to start.
Giffard syrups offer a wide range of flavours, from sweet and fruity to exotic and spicy, and they make it easy to add new dimensions to your drink. For example, try adding a splash of Giffard's Pineapple syrup to your Pina Colada for an extra boost of tropical sweetness. Or, mix in a touch of Giffard's Vanilla syrup to bring out the smooth and creamy notes of this classic cocktail.
Another great way to elevate your Pina Colada is to switch up the rum you use. Instead of using regular white rum, try Black Tears Spiced Cuban rum for a bold and spicy twist. Black Tears rum is made with Cacao, Coffee and Aji Dulce; it adds warm, rich, and complex flavors to your drink. --

  • 30ml coconut cream or Giffard Coconut syrup
  • 30ml pineapple juice
  • Crushed ice
Instructions:

  2. Pour into a glass and garnish with a pineapple wedge or a cherry.

How We Disclose Personal Information

Brazil’s national spirit, cachaça appeared in the 15th century, when the Portuguese brought knowledge of alembic pot distilling to the country. Cachaça Thoquino has been a staple for the people of Brazil for over 100 years. The family distillery, Thomaz de Aquino, carries out all the production process itself from its own sugar cane fields, which guarantees authenticity and quality.
